final: WITH ev AS (SELECT e.type AS event_type, b.link_to_event AS ev_id, AVG(b.spent * 1.0 / b.amount) AS ev_avg FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY b.link_to_event, e.type), ty AS (SELECT event_type, AVG(ev_avg) AS type_avg FROM ev GROUP BY event_type), ov AS (SELECT AVG(type_avg) AS overall_avg FROM ty) SELECT ty.event_type, ty.type_avg, ty.type_avg / ov.overall_avg FROM ty JOIN ov ON ov.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
